mapper.select: SELECT member.memberno, member.membername, member.schoolname, member.grade FROM ttok.member member WHERE member.membername = #{membername}
SELECT member.userid, member.nickname, member.email, member.uuid, member.exp_robot, member.exp_castle, member.gold, member.gem FROM robot.member member WHERE member.userid = #{userid}
mapper.update:
UPDATE robot.member
nickname = #{nickname},
email = #{email},
WHERE userid = #{userid}

UPDATE robot.member
exp_robot = ${exp_robot},
exp_castle = ${exp_castle},
gold = ${gold},
gem = ${gem},
WHERE userid = #{userid}

UPDATE robot.member
exp_robot = exp_robot + ${exp_robot},
exp_castle = exp_castle + ${exp_castle},
gold = gold + ${gold},
gem = gem + ${gem},
WHERE userid = #{userid}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO robot.hist_property ( userid, method, amount, regdate ) VALUES ( #{userid}, #{method}, ${amount}, now() )
